nodes.one_liner_zh: ctx=ubatch=batch=2048（文本 512）、n_seq_max=16、kv_unified、池化 MEAN——写死并进指纹
nodes.one_liner_en: ctx=ubatch=batch=2048 (512 text), n_seq_max=16, kv_unified, MEAN pooling — pinned and fingerprinted
nodes.professional_zh: 推理参数全部冻结：上下文=批次=微批次 2048（纯文本 512）、16 路并发序列、统一 KV、池化 MEAN。这些值决定向量的取值，所以属于嵌入身份——改动任何一个都会触发指纹变化与全量重嵌，这正是设计：不许悄悄动。
nodes.professional_en: All inference params are frozen: ctx=ubatch=batch 2048 (512 for pure text), 16 concurrent sequences, unified KV, MEAN pooling. These values determine vector values, so they belong to the embedding identity — changing any triggers a fingerprint change and full re-embed. That is the design: no silent changes.
nodes.plain_zh: 做向量这道菜的火候和锅型写死在菜谱里。改火候=换了道菜，全库重做，绝不偷偷换。
nodes.plain_en: The stove, the pan, the heat — all fixed in the recipe. Change one and it's a different dish: re-embed everything, never swap silently.
nodes.example_zh: status --json 的 current.embed_id 变过 = 这套参数变过；回看需要备份库。
nodes.example_en: A changed current.embed_id in status --json means these params changed; rolling back needs a backup library.
nodes.analogy_zh: 菜谱锁死，改一味料就要重做全锅
nodes.analogy_en: The recipe is locked; one changed spice re-cooks the pot

nodes.term_zh: 无 KV 记忆的嵌入
nodes.one_liner_zh: gemma-embedding2 没有 KV 记忆（llama.cpp 源码级事实）——常驻省的是加载不是计算图
nodes.one_liner_en: gemma-embedding2 has no KV memory (a llama.cpp source-level fact) — residency saves loading, not a compute graph
nodes.professional_zh: 这类嵌入模型没有 KV 缓存可跨批次保留，每个批次清空重来。所以「常驻」的价值被精确界定：省掉的是每次 spawn 的 ~1GB 模型加载搬运与进程冷启动，不是缓存了什么计算。这也是媒体边车选「一次加载反复嵌入」架构的依据。
nodes.professional_en: This embedding family keeps no KV cache across batches; every batch starts clean. That pins down what residency buys: it saves the ~1GB model load and per-call spawn, not some cached compute. It's also why the media sidecar is 'load once, embed many'.
nodes.plain_zh: 这位厨师每道菜都要从头洗锅——常驻的意义是让他一直站在灶台边，省的是「每次从家叫来」的路程，不是备菜。
nodes.plain_en: This chef washes the pan for every dish. Keeping them in the kitchen saves the commute, not the prep.
nodes.example_zh: serve 常驻前后同一查询的耗时差（几秒 → 亚秒）主要就是这份加载差。
nodes.example_en: The per-query time delta before/after serve (seconds → sub-second) is mostly this load.

nodes.one_liner_zh: spawn → 握手 → 服务 → close 只杀自己拉起的子进程
nodes.one_liner_en: spawn → handshake → serve → close kills only its own children
nodes.professional_zh: 后端生命周期四段：冷启动 spawn（llama-server / embed 边车）、--version + 模型 sha 握手、服务期健康监督、close 按 pid 记账只杀自己 spawn 的进程。「只杀自己的」是血泪纪律——杀掉别人家的 llama-server 是上古事故；健康失败走 NotSupported/BackendStartupError（exit 2）诚实降级，不崩、记录原因、下次再试。
nodes.professional_en: Four phases: cold spawn (llama-server / embed sidecar), a --version + model-sha handshake, supervised serving, then close — which kills only processes it spawned, by pid. 'Only your own children' is scar tissue: killing someone else's llama-server is an ancient incident. A failed handshake degrades honestly via NotSupported/BackendStartupError (exit 2): no crash, reason recorded, retry next time.
nodes.plain_zh: 进程家用账本：生了谁、谁还活着、关门前一个个点名送走。别人家的孩子绝对不碰。
nodes.plain_en: A household ledger: who was spawned, who's alive, and a roll call at closing. Other people's children are never touched.
nodes.example_zh: goldmine serve 启动后 ps 看得到子进程；Ctrl-C 后子进程随之消失且只消失自己的。
nodes.example_en: Start goldmine serve, watch the children in ps; Ctrl-C reaps them — only ours.
nodes.analogy_zh: 关门前点名，只送自己家的孩子
nodes.analogy_en: Roll call at closing; only our kids go home

nodes.one_liner_zh: 照片 140 / 截图 280 / PDF 页 280 / 视频帧 70 token——按类路由并进指纹
nodes.one_liner_en: Photo 140 / screenshot 280 / PDF page 280 / video frame 70 tokens — routed per class, fingerprinted
nodes.professional_zh: 图片进模型前按类分预算（合法档 70–1120）：photo 140、screenshot 280、pdf_page 280、video_frame 70。560 档被 DigUp 实测「2× 慢、真实照片无收益」淘汰。预算值与按类路由规则从第一天起作为冻结常量写进指纹——动预算 = 全库向量过期，不许悄悄动。
nodes.professional_en: Images enter the model under per-class token budgets (legal set 70–1120): photo 140, screenshot 280, pdf_page 280, video_frame 70. The 560 tier was retired by DigUp's measurement: 2× slower, no better on real shots. Budgets and routing rules have been frozen constants in the fingerprint since day one — touch a budget and every vector in the library goes stale, on purpose.
nodes.plain_zh: 不同类型的图给不同「语言额度」：截图文字多给一点，视频帧一闪而过给少点。额度表是冻结常量，改一格全库重嵌——所以有 A/B 实测才改。
nodes.plain_en: Each media class gets its own token allowance: screenshots more, video frames less. The table is frozen — changing one cell re-embeds the library, so it changes only with A/B evidence.
nodes.example_zh: status --json 的指纹 extras 里能看到 media_budgets；换预算的库会被指纹门拒收。
nodes.example_en: media_budgets shows up in the fingerprint extras in status --json; a library built under different budgets gets refused.
nodes.analogy_en: A fixed meal ticket per media class

nodes.one_liner_zh: 多张截图的 OCR 汇成一个批次、一个 leader 线程拉起一次 helper
nodes.one_liner_en: Screenshots' OCR requests merge into one batch; one leader thread spawns the helper once
nodes.professional_zh: F7 省钱机制：同一波里多张截图的 OCR 请求汇进一个批次，由一个 leader 线程一次性拉起 Vision helper——省掉每图一次的进程启动与 Vision 冷启动。批次是 run 级单例（嵌套 run/复用 pipeline 实例时要先想清楚，见腐烂风险清单）。
nodes.professional_en: The F7 economy: OCR requests for all screenshots in a wave merge into one batch, and a single leader thread spawns the helper once — eliminating per-image process startup and Vision cold-start. The batch is a run-level singleton (think twice before nested runs or reused pipeline instances — it's on the rot-risk list).
nodes.plain_zh: 五十张截图 OCR，不是开五十次软件，是把活儿写成一张单子、请一次师傅全办了。
nodes.plain_en: OCR for fifty screenshots is one work order and one summoned specialist — not fifty launches.
nodes.example_zh: 含大量截图的目录 ingest，对比日志里 helper 的 spawn 次数（1 次 vs 每图 1 次）。
nodes.example_en: Ingest a screenshot-heavy folder; the log shows one helper spawn instead of one per image.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 没文字层的 PDF 页：渲染成图 → OCR → 三道质检 → 通过才替换页文本
nodes.one_liner_en: Text-less PDF pages: render to image → OCR → three checks → replace only if all pass
nodes.professional_zh: 对薄页（无文字层或文字病理）的 PDF：pdftoppm 150dpi/1400px 渲染页图（与 DigUp 2000px 的偏差在案）→ Vision OCR → 三道检查（字符量 ≥ 阈值、自身无病理、含预期字符块）→ 全过才替换页文本并记 +arocr 提取器版本变体；任一不过保留原文（诚实回退）并标记走 OCR-redo 升级路径。阿拉伯丢字页是同类机制的特例（arocr-replace 节点）。
nodes.professional_en: For thin pages (no text layer or pathological text): render via pdftoppm at 150dpi/1400px (the deviation from DigUp's 2000px is on record) → Vision OCR → three checks (character mass, self-pathology, expected script block) → replace the page text only if all pass, recording an +arocr extractor-version variant. Any failure keeps the original (honest fallback) and flags the OCR-redo upgrade path. Arabic lost-letter pages are a special case of the same mechanism (see arocr-replace).
nodes.plain_zh: 扫描版 PDF 没有字，就把每页当照片读。读出来的字要过三道检查才配上岗——不过关就老实保留「读不出」的现状，不硬凑。
nodes.plain_en: Scanned PDFs have no text, so each page is read as a photo. The OCR output faces three checks before it may replace anything; fail any and the page honestly stays 'unread'.
nodes.example_zh: 造一个只有图片的 PDF ingest 后 search 其中的词；三查不过的场景在机制测试里有夹具。
nodes.example_en: Ingest an image-only PDF and search its words; the failing-checks path has fixtures in the mechanism tests.
nodes.analogy_zh: 照片先过安检再上岗当文本
nodes.analogy_en: The photo passes security before working as text

nodes.one_liner_zh: 约每 3 秒采一帧、aHash 去重、至多 1200 帧
nodes.one_liner_en: A frame about every 3 s, aHash dedup, hard cap 1200
nodes.professional_zh: 视频按约 3 秒间隔抽帧，aHash 汉明距 ≤4bit 判重去重，maxFrames 1200 封顶；帧按 video_frame 预算（70 token）进图像向量。本机实测 ffmpeg 对 5 分钟 1080p H.264 抽帧 3.88 秒（对照组 macOS 原生 4.07 秒），选型记录在案含反例数据。检索粒度到「时刻」：命中帧回指源视频的 PTS。
nodes.professional_en: Frames are sampled about every 3 seconds, deduped by aHash (Hamming ≤4 bits), capped at 1200, and embedded at the video_frame budget (70 tokens). Measured locally: ffmpeg extracts a 5-min 1080p H.264 in 3.88 s (vs 4.07 s native) — the choice, counterexamples included, is on record. Retrieval granularity is the moment: a hit frame points back to the source video's PTS.
nodes.plain_zh: 视频当「每三秒一张的幻灯片」搜。重复画面靠感知哈希去掉，长视频有 1200 帧上限。命中告诉你是第几秒，open 直接跳过去。
nodes.plain_en: A video is searched like slides, one every ~3 s. Repeats collapse by perceptual hash; long videos cap at 1200 frames. Hits report the second — open jumps there.
nodes.example_zh: 全媒体套件有 8 道关键帧检索题（moment 级定位），历史门 8/8——机制证明，不是自然语言查询质量主张。
nodes.example_en: The full-media suite has 8 keyframe questions (moment-level verdicts), historically 8/8 — a mechanics proof, not a natural-query claim.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 照片的拍摄参数原样进索引当名字可搜的依据
nodes.one_liner_en: Photo capture metadata is indexed verbatim as searchable metadata
nodes.professional_zh: EXIF（机型、时间、GPS 等）按元数据处理：进索引、可被 lookup 型查询命中，但不给内容向量——它不是「内容」。照片的视觉语义由图像向量负责，两条路分工明确。能力行按 metadata_only 记账时原因写明。
nodes.professional_en: EXIF (device, timestamps, GPS) is treated as metadata: indexed and hittable by lookup-style queries, but given no content vector — it isn't content. Visual meaning is the image vector's job; the two roads don't blur. When a photo ends up metadata_only, the capability row says why.
nodes.plain_zh: 照片「什么时候拍的、用什么拍的」当标签搜；「照片里是什么」当图搜。两件事，两条路。
nodes.plain_en: When/what-camera is searchable as tags; what's-in-the-photo is searchable as an image. Two questions, two roads.
nodes.example_zh: search 'iPhone 拍摄 2025-03' 这类元数据查询走 lookup 臂命中 EXIF 行。
nodes.example_en: A query like 'iPhone 2025-03' hits EXIF rows through the lookup arm.
nodes.analogy_zh: 标签归标签，画面归画面
nodes.analogy_en: Tags are tags; pixels are pixels

nodes.one_liner_zh: 30 秒窗 / 25 秒步进 / 16kHz 单声道 / RMS 静音闸
nodes.one_liner_en: 30 s windows, 25 s hop, 16 kHz mono, an RMS silence gate
nodes.professional_zh: 长音频切成 30 秒窗、25 秒步进（5 秒重叠防边界丢词），重采样 16kHz 单声道后过 RMS>0.003 静音闸——全静音窗不产向量不产转写。尾窗只有在携带 ≥2 秒新音频（超出前一窗覆盖）时才保留：按源码语义移植而非字面「长度<2s」（那条字面规则在 30/25 参数下是不可达死代码，62 秒夹具实测尾窗保留、新音频 7 秒）。
nodes.professional_en: Long audio is cut into 30 s windows with a 25 s hop (5 s overlap guards boundary words), resampled to 16 kHz mono, then gated at RMS > 0.003 — all-silent windows produce neither vectors nor transcripts. A tail window survives only if it carries ≥2 s of genuinely new audio beyond the previous window's coverage: a semantic port, not the literal '<2 s' rule, which is unreachable dead code under 30/25 (a 62 s fixture keeps its tail with 7 s new audio).
nodes.plain_zh: 录音切成带 5 秒重叠的 30 秒段；纯静音段直接丢弃；最后一小段只有真带了没听过的新内容才留——省预算也防垃圾向量。
nodes.plain_en: Recordings become 30 s slices with 5 s overlap; pure silence is dropped; the tail survives only if it adds real new audio — saving budget and blocking junk vectors.
nodes.example_zh: 对纯静音 WAV ingest：status 的能力行会给出「为什么没有任何音频向量」。
nodes.example_en: Ingest an all-silent WAV; the capability row explains why no audio vectors exist.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 孟加拉/阿拉伯连字在 PDF 里乱序时，给页图向量再配一条「仅含义」文本向量
nodes.one_liner_en: When Bengali/Arabic ligatures scramble in PDFs, page images get an extra meaning-only text vector
nodes.professional_zh: 复杂文字（孟加拉 glyph 顺序、阿拉伯连字）在 PDF 提取时常以视觉顺序乱序落地——词法臂废了。对策：渲染页图给图像向量之外，把乱序文本再嵌一条「含义专用」向量（模型对词序的敏感度低于词面，实测 R@1 0.75 vs 0.73 乱序对照，DigUp Extractors.swift:108-111 同源）。这条向量明确标注仅含义用途，不参与词法。
nodes.professional_en: Complex scripts (Bengali glyph order, Arabic ligatures) often land scrambled in visual order from PDF extraction — the lexical arm is dead on them. The fix: beyond the page-image vector, embed the scrambled text as a meaning-only vector (the model tolerates word-order noise better than letter noise; measured R@1 0.75 vs 0.73 against the scrambled baseline, same source as DigUp's Extractors.swift:108-111). The vector is explicitly flagged meaning-only and never joins lexical matching.
nodes.plain_zh: 字序被打乱的文字，精确匹配没法用，但「大意」还在。给这段乱码单独算一个「只讲大意」的向量，让语义臂把它捞回来。
nodes.plain_en: Scrambled text can't match exactly, but the gist survives. A dedicated meaning-only vector lets the semantic arm fish it back out.
nodes.example_zh: 含孟加拉/阿拉伯内容的 PDF 在 status 里可见「含义专用」向量标记（media_vectors 路由信息）。
nodes.example_en: Bengali/Arabic PDFs show the meaning-only vector flag in status routing info.

nodes.one_liner_zh: 缩略图在抽取期生成、提交期才嵌入——暂存目录必须是 run 级
nodes.one_liner_en: Thumbnails are made at extraction but embedded at commit — staging must live at run level
nodes.professional_zh: 媒体段的加工（缩略图、窗口、帧）在抽取期完成，嵌入在提交期（一波之后）——中间隔着波次边界。所以暂存目录放在 run 级，不能放在抽取函数的临时目录里：早期版本用完即删，提交期文件已消失，这是个真实踩过的坑（症状：「提交期文件不存在」类 flake），腐烂风险清单第 1 条。
nodes.professional_en: Media processing (thumbnails, windows, frames) happens at extraction; embedding happens at commit — a wave boundary apart. Staging therefore lives at run level, never in the extraction function's temp dir: an early version deleted as it went and the files were gone by commit. A real, stepped-on landmine (symptom: 'file missing at commit' flakes); rot-risk item #1.
nodes.plain_zh: 备菜和下锅隔着一道工序，备好的菜得放在操作台上，不能抓在抽屉里——抽屉一关菜就没了。
nodes.plain_en: Prep and cooking are separate stations; prepped ingredients go on the counter, not in a drawer that closes.
nodes.example_zh: 对大媒体目录 ingest 中途 Ctrl-C：暂存残留会在下一次 run 清理，不留孤儿。
nodes.example_en: Ctrl-C a large media ingest: staging residue is cleaned by the next run — no orphans.
